title: Suggestion : use NTP server for time check in objectives
symptom: AAPS uses the date and time of the 4G connection to verify the real time during objectives, but some phones don't have 4G accounts, causing problems when 4G is turned off.
fix: AAPS already uses an NTP server (time.google.com) for time verification, and connectivity can be via WiFi or any mobile data (3G/4G/5G).
